The cross-shaped metamaterial absorber shows excellent performance in absorbing electromagnetic waves at various frequencies and angles.
The highest peak absorbance performance is achieved at 15 mm of cross-shaped width.
The absorbance performance increases with the width of the cross-shaped unit cell.
The frequency range of the absorbance performance is from 3.4 GHz to 4.8 GHz.
The incident angle range of the absorbance performance is from 200 to 800 degrees.
The polarization angle range of the absorbance performance is from 0 to 360 degrees.
The material used for the metal layer is copper.
The material used for the dielectric layer is FR-4.
The thickness of the copper layer is 0.1 mm.
The thickness of the FR-4 layer is 1.6 mm.
The simulation software used is CST studio suite.
The boundary condition used in the simulation is periodic unit cell.
The transmission (S12) result is very low, indicating that the design is effective in absorbing electromagnetic waves.

The cross-shaped metamaterial absorber is a good alternative for stealth applications due to its high absorbance performance and insensitive polarization.
